items.exampleEn: Heat the milk in a small saucepan.
Most candles are made of wax.
items.exampleZh: 大部分的蠟燭是用蠟做的。

items.exampleEn: Our old freezer makes a strange noise at night.
items.exampleZh: 我們的舊冷凍庫晚上會發出奇怪的聲音。

items.exampleEn: This cake has a chocolate filling.
items.exampleZh: 這個蛋糕有巧克力內餡。

items.exampleEn: We buy diapers at the supermarket every week.
items.exampleZh: 我們每週都在超市買尿布。

items.exampleEn: My wardrobe is full of clothes I never wear.
items.exampleZh: 我的衣櫥塞滿了從來不穿的衣服。

items.exampleEn: Please take off your shoes indoors.

items.sentenceEn: Change the baby's diaper before you leave.
items.sentenceZh: 出門前先幫寶寶換尿布。

items.audioEn: Cats that live indoors usually live longer.
items.audioZh: 住在室內的貓通常活得比較久。
items.questionZh: 住在室內的貓通常怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: Gardening is a good way to relax after work.
items.sentenceZh: 園藝是下班後放鬆的好方法。

items.sentenceEn: My mother makes the pork filling herself.
items.sentenceZh: 我媽媽自己做豬肉內餡。

items.stemEn: Put the meat in the ____ so it stays fresh for weeks.
items.stemZh: 把肉放進冷凍庫，就能保鮮好幾個星期。

items.stemEn: Hang your coat in the ____, please.
items.stemZh: 請把你的外套掛在衣櫃裡。

items.passageEn: My parents' new house is not huge, but it is very comfortable. The kitchen has a big freezer and a set of saucepans. In the bedroom, there is a wooden wardrobe that my father made himself. My mother loves gardening, so the back yard is full of flowers. When it rains, she works indoors and makes pies with apple filling. Once a month, my father puts wax on the wooden floor.
items.passageZh: 我爸媽的新房子不算很大，但非常舒適。廚房裡有一台大冷凍庫和一組長柄鍋。臥室裡有一個爸爸親手做的木頭衣櫃。媽媽很喜歡園藝，所以後院開滿了花。下雨時，她就在室內做蘋果餡的派。爸爸每個月替木頭地板打一次蠟。

items.promptZh: 下雨天孩子們只能待在室內玩。
referenceEn: On rainy days, the children have to play indoors.
When it rains, the kids can only play indoors.
rubricZh: indoors 是副詞「在室內」，前面不加 in
「只能」可寫 have to、can only 等
說的是一般情況，多用現在簡單式

items.instructionZh: 用 gardening 造一個句子，說說你或家人對園藝的看法或習慣。
referenceEn: My grandfather enjoys gardening in the morning.
rubricZh: gardening 是名詞「園藝」，例如當主詞、接在 enjoy、like 後等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
